responsibility: Provides the AVX-512 VPOPCNTDQ + AVX-512VL intrinsic layer for 128-bit and 256-bit 32-bit/64-bit per-element population counts. It exposes masked and unmasked _mm and _mm256 popcnt intrinsics for epi32 and epi64 vectors, complementing the 512-bit definitions in avx512vpopcntdqintrin.h.
